question: Should reasoning-tag parsing now move to one shared stateful tokenizer for static and streaming consumers, or should maintainers explicitly accept this narrowly scoped self-closing repair with its remaining grammar limits?
rationale: The PR body and the code path both show a cross-owner parsing invariant; choosing the permanent grammar boundary and tolerance for malformed or quoted markup is maintainer product and architecture intent, not a mechanical contributor follow-up.

options.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
options.body: Move tag tokenization to one shared stateful owner, migrate both consumers, and prove matching behavior for streaming and complete text.

options.title: Accept the narrow repair
options.body: Merge only if maintainers explicitly accept the current limited grammar and document or track the quoted-delimiter remainder separately.

recommendation.title: Adopt a shared tokenizer
recommendation.body: Move tag tokenization to one shared stateful owner, migrate both consumers, and prove matching behavior for streaming and complete text.
